SUMMARY OF TREATMENT APPROACHES & FREQUENT LOCATIONS
================================================================================

1. Treatment Approaches Observed Most Frequently:
• Targeted Therapies (Small Molecule Inhibitors): A primary focus in the active trial pipeline is precision oncology targeting specific driver mutations, most notably KRAS inhibitors (MK-1084 for KRAS G12C and TSN1611 for KRAS G12D), along with novel molecular entities like BMS-986488 and fingolimod.
• Immunotherapy & Checkpoint Combinations: Standard-of-care anti-PD-1 backbones (primarily Pembrolizumab / Keytruda and Nivolumab / Opdivo) are frequently evaluated either neoadjuvantly for resectable tumors or combined with novel investigational agents and cytokine/anti-inflammatory modulators (e.g., Certolizumab pegol).
• Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs): Highly targeted biological delivery systems carrying cytotoxic payloads to tumor surface antigens, including R-DXD (Raludotatug Deruxtecan) in squamous NSCLC, Ris-Rez (GSK5764227) in relapsed SCLC, and Telisotuzumab Adizutecan targeting c-Met in advanced non-squamous NSCLC.
• Advanced Local, Inhaled, and Image-Guided Modalities: Alternative delivery and ablative techniques to enhance local control while minimizing systemic toxicity, including vascular-targeted photodynamic therapy (Padeliporfin VTP) via robotic bronchoscopy, aerosolized inhaled chemotherapy (Aerosol Gemcitabine), personalized accelerated chemoradiation (PACER), and peptide receptor radionuclide therapy (Lutetium Lu 177 Dotatate).
• Surgical Margin Guidance: Real-time intraoperative near-infrared imaging agents (Abenacianine / VGT-309) to identify residual tumor tissue during surgical resection.
